subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The coin had once bought something ordinary.”?
options: Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.
Centuries later, it bought the town a new understanding of its past.
A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.
A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.
